section.title: Proof & Operations
section.purpose: Define acceptance tests, independent review, pilot, monitoring, rollback and learning governance.

questions.title: Golden cases
questions.prompt: Provide real successful past cases for acceptance tests.
questions.recommendation: Use representative cases; sanitize if needed.

questions.title: Negative cases
questions.prompt: Which examples should make the system abstain, reject, escalate or choose another path?
questions.recommendation: Test failure behavior, not just happy paths.

questions.title: Acceptance criteria
questions.prompt: What must Workflow #1 demonstrate before production release?
questions.recommendation: Specify quality, latency, outcome, approvals, logs and rollback.

questions.title: Independent reviewer
questions.prompt: Who will test and approve who did not build it?

questions.title: Pilot boundary
questions.prompt: What is the smallest safe production slice?
questions.recommendation: Limit users, records, geography, value or action type.

questions.title: Monitoring
questions.prompt: Which failures, delays, unusual actions, costs and business metrics must be monitored?

questions.title: Kill switch
questions.prompt: How can a human disable the workflow immediately?

questions.title: Release rollback
questions.prompt: What is rollback for code, data, configuration and integrations?

questions.title: Sovereign handoff
questions.prompt: Which accounts, repos, data, docs and credentials will the client own at handoff?
questions.recommendation: Owner control is a release criterion.

questions.title: Review cadence
questions.prompt: How often should performance, policies, ontology changes and drift be reviewed?

questions.title: Learning governance
questions.prompt: Who may approve changes suggested by AI or performance data?

questions.title: Expansion rule
questions.prompt: What evidence must exist before Workflow #2 or more agents are added?
questions.recommendation: Do not expand until #1 creates verified value.
